# Hello World!

Getting Started with Git - Setup Instructions

## Creating Your Project

Follow these steps to set up your first Git repository:

```bash
# Create a directory for your project
$ mkdir ~/Hello-World

# Change to the new directory
$ cd ~/Hello-World

# Initialize Git repository
$ git init

# Create README file
$ touch README
```

**Expected output:**
```
Initialized empty Git repository in /Users/your_user_directory/Hello-World/.git/
```
